_comment: Royal Enfield's ONE RIDE 2026. Replaced the old Kangayam-to-Coimbatore entry in this slot. Field notes live in src/data/rides.js.
_verified: The date and edition are Royal Enfield's own, checked against:
· official tagline: Every Rider. Every Road. Everywhere.
· registration is open; the first 1,000 to register get a One Ride tee
COORDINATES are geocoded from OpenStreetMap, not guessed: the Dharapuram
town node (638656) and the Anaikatti village node in Coimbatore North.
Palladam and Coimbatore keep the values already authored in r5 and r7, so
those pins agree across every ride, as does Kariya Kattu Valasu.
DISTANCE is the router's figure for this exact chain — 154.1 km, 2h 35m of
moving time, OSRM, the same router the detail map draws with. By leg:
Ridden as a loop back to the door it is 269.1 km / 4h 28m — see _todo.

home → Dharapuram → Palladam → Coimbatore → the resort. If you ride
back the same day, repeat the `kangayam` stop at the END of `stops`
(same id, icon and dir, so the two pins land as one), mark the
resort stop "dest": true, and set distance to 269 KM. Everything
else — the To figure, the End row, the '· Round Trip' wording —
follows on its own. See ROUND TRIPS in src/data/rides.js.
RESORT PIN — 11.116125, 76.748041 is the ANAIKATTI VILLAGE node, not the
resort gate. The resort's own postal address is Sholayoor Village,
Anaikatti, Mannarkad 678581, and Sholayur geocodes to 11.061361,
76.700204 — about 7 km southwest and OVER THE KERALA BORDER. The
village node is used because Anaikatti is the locality the resort
is named and signposted for, and it is where the road goes. Drop
the real pin from Maps on the day and the distance self-corrects.

resort really does sit at Sholayoor/Mannarkad then the ride crosses
into Kerala and this needs "Kerala" alongside. Worth settling when
the pin is, since `rideSummary` counts states.
distance — 154 KM is the ROUTER's answer for the stops below, not an
odometer reading. Replace it with the real figure after the 20th;
only then does it count, since 'completed' rides feed the totals.
time / rating / stats / photos — after the ride. Move `mode` to 'completed'

name: One Ride 2026
_subtitle: The location line under the title. The event's own tagline used to live here; it is in `highlights` already, and `organizer` names Royal Enfield, so nothing was lost by making this say where the ride goes.
subtitle: Home (Kariya Kattu Valasu) → Dharapuram → Palladam → Coimbatore → Tuskers Hill, Anaikatti
description: Royal Enfield's global One Ride, ridden west to the Anaikatti hills — Dharapuram, Palladam, Coimbatore, then up to Tuskers Hill.
story: One Ride is Royal Enfield's annual worldwide ride, and 2026 is the 15th edition of it: Sunday 20 September, riders in every country out on the same day under one line — Every Rider. Every Road. Everywhere. There is no set course, which is the point of it — you pick the road, and this year the road runs west. Out of Kariya Kattu Valasu to Dharapuram, across to Palladam, into Coimbatore, and then the climb out of the city to Poppys Tuskers Hill Resort at Anaikatti, where the Western Ghats start and the Tamil Nadu plain stops. Registration is open, and the first thousand riders to sign up get the One Ride tee. It falls in the year Royal Enfield turns 125, the oldest motorcycle brand still in continuous production since 1901 — so the Bear's first One Ride lands on a good one.
_stops: Dharapuram is `dharapuram-town` and NOT `dharapuram`: that id already belongs to the Senthur Motors showroom in r1 and r6, and `mapCities` dedups by id, so reusing it would collapse the town into the showroom pin. Same convention as `kangayam-town` in r5 and r6.
